subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: While the lane is unactivated, the lane classifier shall run in shadow — computing and recording lane verdicts without acting — and the recorded verdicts shall support the agreement measurement against actual human dispositions.
rationale: earn enforcement with evidence (GATE-4 rollout posture)
fit_criterion: over the shadow window, every evaluated proposal has a recorded verdict and zero acting side effects; the agreement report is computable from the records alone
